environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. ALB is configured with a standard HTTPS listener (port 443) using a server certificate. No client certificate authentication is configured on the ALB. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The container runs with NET_ADMIN capability and AllowUnsafeBlocks is enabled in the project. No rate limiting or request throttling is applied.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, no mutual TLS
